summary: NO_PUBLIC_FACTOR_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_READY_WAIT. Four-family closure matrix: Deribit BTC options is WAIT_FOR_NAMED_POINT_IN_TIME_PROOF for exact snapshot completeness, instrument-universe coverage, retention, revision, continuity and reuse terms; OKX liquidation events is CLOSE_SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT because the accepted sealed audit records recent-only, non-total, potentially nonchronological events and removed historical REST retrieval; mempool congestion/fee state is WAIT_FOR_NAMED_POINT_IN_TIME_PROOF for a frozen point-in-time schema, observation timestamp, revision, retention and continuity contract. CFTC V2 is WAIT_FOR_ACCEPTED_HEADERLESS_TRANSPORT_PROOF because no listed Manager-accepted result proves the full fixed-enum headerless positional transport. Therefore no public factor source has accepted point-in-time transport evidence ready for later factor review. Immediate fee-adjusted PnL and drawdown effect are zero; predictive and economic value remain MISSING_PROOF. Opportunity cost is bounded by closing duplicate documentation/parser work while accepting delayed learning until independently sealed transport proof exists.
